sourcePolicy: Local working tree, tests, diagnostics, scripts, RefPlan5, local Git history and exact package restore only; no remote Git.

phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 06 Canonical IR boundary, Phase 08A target-machine contract and Phase 08B target-platform contract.
phaseGate.output: A separate optional LLVM adapter with an exact LLVM 20.1.2/LLVMSharp 20.1.2 public-C-API contract, fail-closed module validation and deterministic structural import provenance.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: LLVM supplies validated frontend structure and evidence only. Core independently owns Canonical IR and target legality; the adapter has no scheduling, backend, runtime, execution, publication, commit or retire authority.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Missing or mismatched native runtime is Unavailable; malformed, incompatible, over-budget or unsupported IR is rejected before Canonical IR creation. No host defaults or wall-clock budget select code.

phase04Through09BroadCompatibilitySlice.scopeNote: Intentional recorded superset: legacy test classes sharing phase labels are included; this total is not presented as the narrow RefPlan5 cumulative total.

prequalificationDiagnostic.cause: An initial Release test invocation was rejected because the test project intentionally forbids internal test hooks in Release.
prequalificationDiagnostic.disposition: Tests ran once to completion under the established Debug testsupport profile; Release compiler builds were qualified independently.

releaseDisposition.defaultEnabledScope: The optional LLVM adapter is explicit-only; Core and Native defaults remain LLVM-free.
releaseDisposition.releaseDisposition: Qualified as the Phase 10 prerequisite only. Semantic lowering, backend emission and final release authorization remain disabled.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Define a table-driven semantic firewall from validated LLVM IR to frontend-neutral Canonical IR and provenance-qualified analysis facts. Unsupported or lossy semantics reject deterministically or use an explicitly verified helper; LLVM facts cannot override Phase 08 legality.
